slug: 2026-02-03 Liberia Unveils 5-Year 'Digital Liberia' Strategy to Boost Sovereignty and Innovation

systems.system: Digital Liberia: Equity, Sovereignty and Innovation for a Connected Future (Strategic Plan 2025-2029)

note: The article describes Digital Liberia as the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications' Strategic Plan 2025-2029, launched at a ministry event, with no adopting act, text, cost or report stated; classed as the document describes it, so no fact is recorded.
